hero.headline: A place for the phone, outside the door.
hero.sub: Safeguard hangs on the hallway side of bedroom and bathroom doors, so your family's no-phones rule is easy to keep and easy to see.

features.f3sub: Only the top of the phone shows
features.f4sub: Reuse it on any suitable door

product.title: What it is
product.description: A phone-sized sleeve that holds the phone outside the door. It covers the screen and leaves only the top of the phone showing.
product.materialsLine: washable canvas with a soft-touch silicone back
product.fourPackLine: One for each bedroom and bathroom door.
product.detail1: Six built-in suction cups. No drilling and no adhesive, and it can be moved to another door.
product.detail2: Covers the screen and leaves only the top of the phone visible from the hallway.
product.detail3: Cable hole in the bottom for your own charger. Charger not included.
product.detail4: Plain cream front with no logo. Nothing to charge and nothing to set up.

routine.sub: Parents dock their phones too. It is a house habit, not a rule aimed at one person.
routine.step1: Press the sleeve onto the hallway side of each bedroom and bathroom door.
routine.step2: Choose what works for your family, such as no phones in bathrooms, or phones docked from 9pm.
routine.step3: Before going in, put the phone into that door's Safeguard.
routine.step4: The top of the phone shows, so there is nothing to ask.
routine.step5: Leave the phone outside the door overnight. Some families collect them to charge in the parents' room.

doors.title: Which doors it is made for
doors.note: Suction cups hold best on smooth, non-porous doors such as gloss or semi-gloss paint, laminate, glass and metal. They are not recommended on flat or matte paint, textured doors or bare wood. We have not finished testing yet, so every finish is marked untested.
doors.expected: Expected to hold. Bench test pending.
doors.pass: Tested: held for the full test.

buy.title: Get your Safeguards
buy.why: Four sleeves, so every bedroom and bathroom door has its own place for the phone.

faq.title: Questions.
faq.a1: Most families want one Safeguard on each bedroom door and each bathroom door. The 4-pack covers four doors, with free shipping.
faq.a2: It is sized for common phone sizes. We are still finalising the exact dimensions, including for phones in cases, so we will confirm before the 4-pack ships.
faq.q3: Do I need an outlet by the door?
faq.a3: Only if you want to charge the phone there. The cable hole in the bottom lets your own charger reach the phone. A charger is not included.
faq.a4: No. This is a pre-order and no payment is taken. We will email you before anything ships.
faq.a5: Hand-wash the canvas front and wipe the silicone back clean.
faq.q6: Can I move it to another door?
faq.a6: Yes. The suction cups use no adhesive, so you can move the sleeve to another suitable door or room.
